name: Portstone
one_line: A cold-calling agency: it assigns trained callers to a B2B campaign and runs it end to end, from the target list to the meetings on the client's calendar.

asked.by: Dinis, met at the summit; relayed by attendees.1.fringe@PrompTugal.dinis

note: Facts are from their own public pages, each with its source and read time. What they told us at the summit is marked as such and is not on their pages. The hypothesis and the suggestions are ours and say so.

artefacts.title: This partner brief: Portstone
artefacts.note: asked for by name at the summit, 2026-11-12T10:35Z

artefacts.title: Their own site: portstone.io
artefacts.note: read by hand for this brief

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Describes itself as a cold calling agency that assigns trained callers to a campaign and runs it end to end, from the target list to the meetings on the client's calendar.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Services: outbound strategy, list building, script writing, SDR placement and training, cold calling, and weekly campaign reporting.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Every call on every campaign is recorded; recordings come with the weekly report, attached to the record they belong to.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Works backwards from the client's revenue goal to the dial volume and connect rate needed, and checks every row of a list for the right company, person and role before calling.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Pricing per campaign: Starter $2,000 (500 dials), Growth $3,500 (1,000 dials), Scale $5,000 (1,500 dials, multiple callers), Custom on request; no setup fees, no long-term contract.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Says it has called into law, agency, B2B SaaS, consulting, salestech, recruiting, financial advisory and other markets, and does not guarantee meetings.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Its callers are people, selected, trained and managed by Portstone; the site names no AI agents in its own process.

told: A fractional SDR and cold-calling service that builds outbound pipeline for B2B tech companies.
domain_note: No domain was given. portstone.io ('Portstone · Cold calling agency') matches the service described; portstone.com and portstone.co.uk are unrelated paving companies. Not yet confirmed by the company.

help.label: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
help.pitch: Portstone's own work is done by people, not AI agents, so RiskMandate's measurement is not the first fit. The fit Dinis sees is the other way round: Portstone as an outbound phone channel for RiskMandate's agent-risk assessments and the summit packages, calling B2B tech companies that run AI agents.

mandate.text: Unknown for agents: the site describes human callers working from an approved script and list. The script is a written mandate for a caller.

reach.text: Its process touches client target lists, call recordings and CRM-style records. Whether any AI tooling sits behind list sourcing or connect-rate optimisation is unknown from public pages.

gap.text: Unknown. If Portstone adds AI to list sourcing, dialling or reporting, the mandate, reach and gap measurement applies there.

together.label: Our suggestions. Nothing here is agreed.
